README.md

cloudy-h-webapps-mob (renamed from cloud-webapps, cloud-h-webapps and cloudy-h-webapps; the published Pages path stays /cloud-webapps/)

🐧 Unix 1 › ☁️ Cloudy 1.1 › WebApps 1.1.4

Cloud web apps: the SuperApp + fleet mimic (/cloud-webapps/) and the C3 console (/cloudy-c3/), one SvelteKit workspace

CodeVisibilityHubDeveloperFarm folder
1.1.4.1🌐 publiccloudy-___ 1.1.0Leaf.y1.1.Cloudy/

One independent site per Cloud APK (cloud-mail, cloud-drive, ...), all sharing one generated top nav (_shared/dist/nav.js). Moved out of diegonmarcos.github.io/cloud-webapps (#1062). Pages is still served by diegonmarcos.github.io, which pins this repo as a submodule; .github/workflows/bump-pages.yml bumps that pin on every push.

Note: scripts/gen-nav.mjs still reads ../a_Portals/cloud-superapp/... from the Pages repo layout; it runs there until the list is vendored here.
